title: French Vegetable Gratin
description: A classic French dish made with layers of sautéed vegetables and creamy sauce, baked to perfection.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the carrots, zucchini, and yellow squash.
In a large saucepan, sauté the sliced vegetables in 2 tablespoons of butter until they start to soften.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
In a separate saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk to make a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the heavy cream, whisking continuously to prevent lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of sautéed vegetables.
Pour some of the creamy sauce over the vegetables, followed by a sprinkle of Gruyère cheese.
Repeat the layers one more time, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the vegetables are tender.
